svg.title: Conditional phase by fill
svg.desc: D5's conditional phase from Z2's readout, in degrees, for each fill of its idle window: no fill +2.15, 1 flip +0.29, 2 flips -1.51, 4 flips -0.10. One flip cancels most of it, two flips overshoot, four cancel it again.
